scientific_integrity: An arbitrary-n alternating-trace proof is given. Exact executable independent checks for cycle types n=5..9 and direct oriented chain traces at n=5,6 support but do not substitute for the proof. Both the prior general nonequivariant theorem and known n=6 representation are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The theorem describes rational symmetric-group representations and rational quotient homology for ordinary open-neighborhood complexes of KG(n,2), n>=5. The nonequivariant sphere-wedge homotopy theorem, its Betti rank, and the six-label representation were previously established. No integral equivariant lattice, positive-characteristic representation, equivariant homotopy type, or integral quotient classification is asserted. Publication priority is provisional and independent audit is absent.
title: The uniform symmetric-group character of two-subset Kneser neighborhood homology
